name: reported-paths

symbols: selfTest legs: fabrication, honest-empty, written, anti-vacuous-zero-handoffs, route-never-resolved

volatile: The scanner, valuesAt, isPathShaped and PATH_SHAPED_EXTRA are unchanged. The declaration's 16 rows are unchanged in boundary, path, kind, author and roots; each row's prose note is shortened to one line.

The parity leg (discoverPathShapedFields, checkParity), which holds the declaration to the generated envelope schema on every commit, is not carried: the schema is not published here. The 16-row inventory is copied, not re-derived.

The mode switch (REPORTED_PATHS_MODE) and the report file are not carried; run.ts owns the exit contract. Four of the factory's nine self-test legs run here, over committed fixture handoffs instead of temp-planted ones.
The fixture handoffs carry only the fields the scanner reads (handoff_boundary, boundary_payload, route_reports); they are not full envelopes and are not schema-validated here.

tamper.find: if (existsSync(abs)) { exists = true; resolvedAt = abs; break; }
tamper.replace: if (abs) { exists = true; resolvedAt = abs; break; }
tamper.expect_line: SELF_TEST_FAILED — refusing to report a scan clean.
